gaps.sentence: My laptop ___ (service) next week, so back up your files beforehand.
gaps.explanation: 'Next week' takes the future passive: will be + serviced (is being serviced is also a valid arrangement).

gaps.sentence: I couldn't use the meeting room because it ___ (clean) all morning.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was being + cleaned over a period in the past.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: The company ___ (say) to be on the verge of bankruptcy.
gaps.explanation: It is said that... → The company is said to be... Present simple passive: is said.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't pay because her wallet ___ (steal) at the market.
gaps.hint: earlier past action causing a past problem
gaps.explanation: The theft happened before the failed payment: past perfect passive, had been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: Construction ___ (halt) after the discovery of Roman remains.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + halted. The halting authority is unnamed.

gaps.sentence: The fault ___ by the time the auditor arrived.
gaps.explanation: The fixing preceded the arrival: past perfect passive had been + fixed.

gaps.sentence: A decision ___ once all the evidence has been reviewed.
gaps.explanation: The decision cannot make itself: future passive will be + made.
